title: How we fit an NES game into 40 Kilobytes
summary: Morphcat Games explains how they fit Micro Mages, a full-featured NES game, into 40 kilobytes. It covers compression of sprites and level layouts and other space-saving tricks.
why: HN points to it whenever discussion turns to how old games were so small, as a clear tour of 8-bit optimization and creative work under hardware limits.

quote.text: Here is my favorite video about 8-bit era optimisations. Makes you appreciate games from this era even more.
